definitions.explanation: The landlocked prefecture just north of Tokyo. Its capital is Saitama City, written in hiragana as さいたま{市|し}.

examples.japanese: {埼玉|さいたま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Saitama is a prefecture with no coastline.

examples.japanese: {埼玉|さいたま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}くて→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{住|す}み→住む：00673_sumu⟧やすい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Saitama is said to be an easy place to live, since it is close to Tokyo and rents are cheaper.

notes:
A classic commuter-belt prefecture, and a frequent target of friendly jokes about being unremarkable; the comedy film {翔|と}んで{埼玉|さいたま} played on this.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {埼玉県|さいたまけん}: Saitama Prefecture
- さいたま⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧: Saitama City (written in hiragana)
- {浦和|うらわ}, {大宮|おおみや}: former cities now part of Saitama City

WATCH OUT:
The prefecture is written {埼玉|さいたま} in kanji, but the city is officially さいたま⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ in hiragana.
